architecture.mechanism: Surfactant-induced Marangoni eddy creates radially inward surface flow that opposes the outward radial flow, resulting in a heterogeneous deposition profile
architecture.intervention: Apply a specialized elastomeric coating on the leading edge containing hydrophilic/hydrophobic gradients that act as surfactants; this creates a Marangoni effect where surface tension gradients generate inward flow against incoming rain/hail droplets, reducing erosive impact velocity
architecture.expected_effect: Reduced kinetic energy transfer to the composite surface lowers erosion rate, extending blade life and reducing annual energy production loss
architecture.falsification_test: Wind tunnel test with simulated hail bombardment measuring coating mass loss and comparing erosion rates of blades with and without the Marangoni-active coating
